main-header: Join MFS — the most reliable and loyal fleet for food delivery couriers in the Czech Republic!
main-subheader: Register in just 5 minutes and start delivering.

transport-intro.line1: We provide transport for couriers in an "all-inclusive" format — just take it and start working right away.
transport-intro.line2: The price already includes maintenance, repairs, and all necessary equipment — no extra costs or downtime.
transport-intro.line3: Monthly payments come with better pricing.

bike.title: Regular Bikes
bike.line1: A simple and reliable option to get started.
bike.line2: Low cost, maximum efficiency. Full service included.

ebike.title: E-bikes
ebike.line1: The most popular choice among couriers. Fast, convenient, and less tiring.
ebike.line2: From 1,250 CZK per week, including maintenance, repairs, and full equipment.

escooter.title: E-scooters
escooter.line1: Perfect for short distances and city centers.

car.title: Cars
car.line1: For those who want to handle more orders and work in any weather.

transport-footnote: * No deposit is required for most vehicles. A deposit is required for cars. Regular wear and tear is covered by us, but in case of an accident, the driver is responsible for the damage.

steps: Pick up the vehicle and the delivery box

why-us.title: Why should you choose us?
why-us.support-link-aria: Write to MFS support in Telegram

item1.title: 1. Salary 4 times a month
item1.line1: Get your money often and without delays!
item1.line2: Forget about “waiting until the end of the month.”
item1.line3: We pay you every week – reliably, on time, by Wednesday at the latest!

item2.title: 2. We handle all the paperwork:
item2.line1: including your registration, documents, and formalities – everything is done quickly and without your involvement.
item2.line2: You just hop on the car / bike / scooter and start earning!

item3.title: 3. Electric transport without deposits or hidden fees,
item3.line1: including equipment and service fully covered in the rental price
item3.line2: Take it and go — no deposits, no headaches!

items.title: Submit an application
items.text: Fill out the form in 5 minutes. We will contact you within an hour, explain the terms, and help choose transport.

items.title: Pick up transport and a thermal bag
items.text: Come to our office in Prague, we handle the documents and provide transport with equipment right away. No deposits for bikes and electric transport.

items.title: Go online and earn
items.text: Register with Bolt Food or Foodora and start taking orders. Payouts are 4 times a month, support is available 7 days a week.
